title: Build Assist Wands
description: Adds multiple wands that assist with block placement, making building and exploration more convenient.
body:
**Build Assist Wands** is a small Minecraft mod that adds three types of building-assist wands.

When you place a block while holding a wand in your offhand, the wand automatically searches for a placement position based on its type.

This makes it easy to build pillars, walls, floors, bridges, and stairs, making building and exploration more convenient.


# **✨Wands**

Each wand has material tiers similar to vanilla Minecraft tools.

Wooden
Stone
Iron
Golden
Diamond
Netherite

Netherite wands cannot be crafted directly in a crafting table.

To obtain a Netherite wand, upgrade the corresponding Diamond wand using a Smithing Table.

Higher-tier wands have a larger maximum block placement range.


## Wall Wand

![Wall Wand Recipes](https://i.imgur.com/nQi9L8q.gif)

Searches upward and places a block at the first available space.

Useful for building walls, pillars, and vertical structures.

![Wall Wand](https://i.imgur.com/F5qWWYE.gif)


## Bridge Wand

![Wall Wand Recipes](https://i.imgur.com/tikbPJp.gif)

Searches horizontally and places a block at the first available space.

Useful for extending bridges, floors, platforms, and straight paths.

![Wall Wand Recipes](https://i.imgur.com/KQuJ41N.gif)


## Stair Wand

![Wall Wand Recipes](https://i.imgur.com/xBcTaBV.gif)

Searches diagonally upward and places a block at the first available space.

Useful for building stair-like paths and diagonal upward structures.

![Wall Wand Recipes](https://i.imgur.com/lie98jf.gif)


# 📖Enchantment

## Extension

A wand-specific enchantment that increases the maximum search range.

Extension I: +3 blocks

Extension II: +6 blocks

Extension III: +9 blocks

Extension IV: +12 blocks

Extension V: +15 block


# 💡How to Use

Hold a wand in your offhand.

Hold the block you want to place in your main hand.

Right-click to place a block.

The wand searches in its direction and places the block at the first available empty space.

Sneaking disables the wand effect and allows normal block placement.


# ⚙️Configuration

You can configure the maximum search range for each material tier and the bonus range of the Extension enchantment.

Generated config file:

config/buildassistwands-common.toml


### Notes

Some special blocks may not behave exactly the same as normal manual placement.
If you encounter an issue, please report the block type and the situation where it happened.
